program:
PARAMS = {
    "W1":  (1.6, 0.8, 4.0),     # gm nfet width per finger [um]
    "L1":  (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # gm nfet L
    "W3":  (2.0, 0.8, 6.0),     # nfet cascode width per finger
    "L3":  (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),     # cascode L
    "W2":  (8.0, 3.0, 20.0),    # pfet load width per finger
    "L2":  (1.5, 0.8, 4.0),     # pfet load L (sets gain / f3db)
    "Rb":  (3.0e6, 1.5e6, 5e6), # divider segment setting vbn - vref
}

M = 4  # main/replica current ratio (identical fingers)

def _bisect(f, lo, hi, it=50):
    flo = f(lo)
    for _ in range(it):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        fm = f(mid)
        if (fm > 0) == (flo > 0):
            lo, flo = mid, fm
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)

    # divider: vdd -Ra- vbn -Rb- vref -Rc- vss ; vref = DC bias of vin
    Rtot = 18e6
    Rc = Rtot * vin / vdd
    Rb = min(p["Rb"], Rtot - Rc - 1e6)
    Ra = Rtot - Rc - Rb
    vbn = vdd * (Rc + Rb) / Rtot

    W1, L1, W3, L3, W2, L2 = p["W1"], p["L1"], p["W3"], p["L3"], p["W2"], p["L2"]

    # per-finger operating point (replica == one finger, main == M identical fingers)
    vx, vout = 0.3, 0.8
    vgs3 = 0.7
    vsg = 0.8
    for _ in range(30):
        o1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, max(vx, 0.02))
        Id = o1["Id"]
        vds3 = max(vout - vx, 0.05)
        vxx = vx
        vgs3 = _bisect(lambda v: lut.op("n", W3, L3, v, vds3, vsb=vxx)["Id"] - Id, 0.3, 1.6)
        vx_new = max(vbn - vgs3, 0.02)
        vsg = _bisect(lambda v: lut.op("p", W2, L2, v, v)["Id"] - Id, 0.3, 1.75)
        vout_new = vdd - vsg
        vx = 0.5 * vx + 0.5 * vx_new
        vout = 0.5 * vout + 0.5 * vout_new
    o1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vin, vx)
    o3 = lut.op("n", W3, L3, vgs3, max(vout - vx, 0.05), vsb=vx)
    o2 = lut.op("p", W2, L2, vsg, vsg)

    gm1, gds1 = o1["gm"], o1["gds"]
    gm3, gds3 = o3["gm"], o3["gds"]
    gmb3 = 0.2 * gm3
    Rdn = 1 / gds3 + 1 / gds1 + (gm3 + gmb3) / (gds3 * gds1)
    gout = 1 / Rdn + o2["gds"]
    A = gm1 / gout

    Cout = cl + M * 0.3 * (o2["cgg"] + o3["cgg"])
    gbw = M * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cout)
    f3db = M * gout / (2 * PI * Cout)
    Itot = (M + 1) * o1["Id"] + iref + vdd / Rtot
    power = vdd * Itot
    vmin = vx + 0.1
    vmax = vdd - 0.15
    swing = min(vmax - vmin, 2 * min(vout - vmin, vmax - vout))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # main amplifier: M identical fingers of the replica unit
    n.M("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=M)
    n.M("M3", "vout", "vbn", "x", "vss", "nfet", W3, L3, m=M)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "vpg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, L2, m=M)
    # replica (1 finger), gate at exact DC bias
    n.M("M1R", "xr", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1, m=1)
    n.M("M3R", "vpg", "vbn", "xr", "vss", "nfet", W3, L3, m=1)
    n.M("M2R", "vpg", "vpg", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, L2, m=1)
    # bias divider
    n.R("RA", "vdd", "vbn", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "vbn", "vref", Rb)
    n.R("RC", "vref", "vss", Rc)
    # IREF sink (diode-connected nfet)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 1.0, m=1)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": 20 * math.log10(A),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }

events.topology: NMOS-cascoded CS amplifier, long-L PMOS current-source load biased by an exact 1:M replica (gate at divider-generated 0.75 V)

events.reason: The program uses the forbidden word 'input' in a comment. Removed it; topology and sizing unchanged so we get a first simulation baseline.

Fingering bug: n.M takes per-finger W, so the main stage was 16x the replica (power 3x) with different narrow-width Vth. Replica tracking broke, vout fell to 0.19 V and M3 went triode. Using W=W1, m=M
